objective: R40 lifecycle-safety hardening after deep line-level audit

confirmedFindings.finding: R39 tray Full Exit called ExitAll(0) directly without verified owned-runtime cleanup.
confirmedFindings.fix: ExitCleanly invokes fail-closed cleanup and exits only after cleanup exit 0.

confirmedFindings.finding: R39 UI update install path did not independently reject active/stale FreeNetHub-owned runtime before installer launch.
confirmedFindings.fix: UI and Prepare-Upgrade now fail closed on active/unverifiable Gateway/Direct-DPI/runtime state.

confirmedFindings.finding: Gateway apply/stop had best-effort cleanup branches that could return after silent rollback failure.
confirmedFindings.fix: Critical rollback removals/restores are verified and fail closed on residue.

confirmedFindings.finding: Unparseable local/remote revision could previously be treated as update-available.
confirmedFindings.fix: Revision comparison now requires parseable positive local and remote revisions and selects highest revisioned installer asset.

confirmedFindings.finding: Linux close/shutdown lifecycle lacked explicit hide-on-close plus owned-runtime cleanup on real shutdown/signals.
confirmedFindings.fix: Close hides; shutdown/SIGTERM/SIGINT invokes browser and console cleanup.
